) said on Monday that it has priced an underwritten public offering of $1.25B aggregate principal amount of its senior notes.
The offering comprises a $600M aggregate principal amount of 5.750% notes due 2029 and a $650M aggregate principal amount of 6% notes due 2031.

The company expects to use the net proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes, which may include, but are not limited to, the repayment at maturity of all the company's outstanding $300M aggregate principal amount of 3% notes due November 15, 2026, and the repayment or redemption of other indebtedness or other corporate obligations.
The offering is expected to close on or about November 2, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

title: Southwest Airlines prices $1.25B notes offering
